rationale: The compiled human_exception_required route is truthful workflow provenance and must not be rewritten.
The user has already completed the exceptional review through a content-bound ratification and risk-treatment receipt.
The Semantic IR compiler applies blocks_behavioral_propositions only to accepted action IDs when deriving behavioral eligibility.
The presentation tier currently treats any blocks_behavioral_propositions constraint as a global receipts-only blocker, including constraints attached only to context-only or rejected controls.
The accepted contract states that context-only and rejected actions do not enter the substantive denominator, while a blocking constraint on an accepted directional action blocks the result.
The correction must distinguish resolved human-exception routing from unresolved semantic blocking without allowing approval to override a true accepted-substantive blocker.
The existing human_exception_required value is not itself converted to standard_generation_pass; semantic quality and editorial approval remain independent axes.

exception_resolution_must_bind: compiled Semantic IR and review route
source/render constraints and affected action IDs
user ratification and selected risk treatments
required_architecture.noncounting_control_rule: A blocks_behavioral_propositions constraint attached solely to context-only or rejected actions may preserve those actions as visible non-proposition controls without globally downgrading an otherwise complete reviewed conclusion.
required_architecture.resolution_preference: Prefer the existing content-bound full-record validation, user-ratification, synthesis-approval, and production-eligibility chain. Add a narrow compatibility or exception-resolution receipt only if the current publication contract cannot consume that chain directly. Do not create a second discretionary approval system.
required_architecture.tier_implementation_preference: Correct public-tier derivation so blocks_behavioral_propositions is a global block only when it applies to an accepted substantive action. Method boundaries already identify context-only controls and rejected exact actions; use authoritative eligibility/accounting rather than action titles or case-specific IDs.
required_architecture.tier_rule: A human_exception_required result may become reviewed_conclusion only when an exact content-bound resolution receipt closes every exception and no blocking constraint applies to an accepted substantive action. A blocked route, missing evidence, unresolved service, partial episode, or accepted-substantive source block remains receipts_only and cannot be approved away.

required_regressions: human_exception_required plus exact completed resolution and no substantive blocker may derive reviewed_conclusion
human_exception_required without a resolution receipt remains nonpublishable
blocking constraint on an accepted substantive action remains receipts_only even with approval
blocking constraints only on context-only or rejected controls do not globally block after exact review resolution
mixed trajectory remains visible and limiting rather than being erased to gain eligibility
roll 155 remains context-only, non-counting, and source-conflicted
member or party mutation cannot change routing
resolution receipt cannot change propositions, conclusion plan, wording, or mappings
